mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_access (access_id, wallet_id, member_id, invited_by, role, status) VALUES (#{accessId}, #{walletId}, #{memberId}, #{invitedBy}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE shared_access SET status = #{status} WHERE access_id = #{accessId}
mapper.select: SELECT sa.*, m.nickname, m.email FROM shared_access sa JOIN member m ON sa.member_id = m.member_id WHERE sa.wallet_id = #{walletId}
